MedMosaic · documents: The MedMosaic card documents multiple-choice, free-form and multi-turn answer layouts.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.medmosaic.answer-layouts.v2

  • A documented answer schema is not a complete labeling, adjudication or evaluation protocol.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedMosaic · benchmark task: The anonymous MedMosaic creator card describes a medical audio question-answering evaluation collection linking recordings to questions and expected answers.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.medmosaic.audio-qa-scope.v2

  • The publishing account is anonymous; this card does not establish Centific authorship, recruitment or annotation delivery.
  • Only the public card was read; no clinical accuracy, recording provenance, consent or payload integrity audit was conducted.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedMosaic · dataset size: The MedMosaic card lists 4, 661 examples across seven task folders: 106 long-form, 6 multi-turn, 691 open-ended, 1, 417 sound-only, 1, 174 speech-only, 1, 087 speech-and-sound and 180 voice examples.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.medmosaic.task-units.v2

  • Folder/example counts are creator-declared evaluation units, not independently counted recordings, patients or seven distinct dataset families.
